question: Round 3 (technical plus aptitude) of the Zoho Software Debug Engineer process had: **10 aptitude questions, implementation of an LRU cache, database schema design, and SQL queries using INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN**. The exact schema and queries were not specified, so expect to choose a simple domain and explain it.
lookingFor: Can you combine a hash map and a linked list to get O(1) get and put?
Can you design a normalised schema with keys and relationships?
Do you understand how each join type treats unmatched rows?
Do you handle edge cases such as capacity, updates, and null values?
answer:
**LRU cache**

Need: `get(key)` and `put(key, value)` in O(1); when full, evict the least recently used entry.

Design: a **hash map** from key to node, plus a **doubly linked list** ordered by recency (head is most recent, tail is least recent).

- `get`: look up the node, move it to the head, return the value (or -1).
- `put`: if the key exists, update and move to head; otherwise insert at head, and if size exceeds capacity remove the tail node and its map entry.

In Java, `LinkedHashMap` with access order and `removeEldestEntry` does this. Mention thread safety (lock or `ConcurrentHashMap` plus careful list updates) if asked.

**Schema design (example: students and courses)**

- `student(id PK, name, email UNIQUE)`
- `course(id PK, title)`
- `enrollment(student_id FK, course_id FK, grade, PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_id))`

Explain keys, a many-to-many link table, normalisation (no repeated groups), and indexes on foreign keys.

**Joins**

```sql
-- only students who have enrollments
SELECT s.name, c.title FROM student s
INNER JOIN enrollment e ON e.student_id = s.id
INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id;

-- all students, even without enrollments (NULL title)
SELECT s.name, e.course_id FROM student s
LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.student_id = s.id;

-- all enrollments/courses, even with no matching student
SELECT s.name, e.course_id FROM student s
RIGHT JOIN enrollment e ON e.student_id = s.id;
```

INNER keeps matched rows only; LEFT keeps all rows from the left table; RIGHT keeps all from the right. Find students with no enrollment using `LEFT JOIN ... WHERE e.student_id IS NULL`.
followUps: How would you make the LRU cache thread-safe?
What is the time complexity of each operation and why?
What is the difference between LEFT JOIN and FULL OUTER JOIN?
How would you add an index to speed up the join and how do you verify it is used?
